title: New evidence of strong but slow portfolio responses to equity premium changes
title_zh: 股票溢价变化下投资组合反应强烈但缓慢的新证据
title_primary: 股票溢价变化下投资组合反应强烈但缓慢的新证据
title_secondary: New evidence of strong but slow portfolio responses to equity premium changes
authors: Andreas Fagereng, Luigi Guiso, Marius Ring
abstract: Standard portfolio theory predicts strong investor responses to changes in the equity premium, but empirical evidence has found much lower sensitivity. This column studies the effects of changes in the Norwegian wealth tax, which generated variation in the after-tax equity premium. It finds that investors adjusted strongly, but slowly, with adjustment continuing for several years. This is consistent with the presence of adjustment frictions, such as attention or information costs. The findings can also help reconcile household portfolio behaviour with standard levels of risk aversion.
abstract_zh: 标准投资组合理论预测投资者会对股权溢价变化作出强烈反应，但实证证据显示其敏感度远低于此。本文研究了挪威财富税变动的影响，该变动导致了税后股权溢价的差异。研究发现，投资者调整幅度显著但过程缓慢，调整持续数年之久。这与调整摩擦的存在相符，如注意力或信息成本。这些发现也有助于调和家庭投资组合行为与标准风险厌恶水平之间的关系。

title: Environmental Regulation Informed by Biased Stakeholders
title_zh: 受偏见利益相关者影响的环境规制
title_primary: 受偏见利益相关者影响的环境规制
title_secondary: Environmental Regulation Informed by Biased Stakeholders
authors: Stefan Ambec, Jessica Coria, William Parker, Johannes Spinnewijn, David Dorn
official: 官方在线 2025-05-24 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a framework to analyze how a regulator should process information provided by biased stakeholders. We distinguish between stakeholders whose biases are high and known and those whose biases are small but unknown, such as national authorities. We show that the regulator should follow the advice that runs counter to a stakeholder's typical bias, i.e., to regulate if firms so advise, and not to regulate if environmental organizations so advise. Without such advice, she should prioritize the comments provided by stakeholders with smaller but unknown bias. Next, we contrast our theoretical results with the regulation of chemicals in the European Union. In line with our theory, we find that support for regulation has a strong and significant impact on the decision to regulate when the support comes from firms but not when it comes from NGOs and environmental agencies. We also find that national authorities have a stronger influence than other stakeholders in the regulation decision, both by the number of comments and the relative support.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个分析框架，用以探讨监管者应如何处理由具有偏见的利益相关者所提供的信息。我们将利益相关者区分为两类：一类是偏见程度高且为人所知的，另一类是偏见程度小但不为人知的，例如国家当局。研究表明，监管者应当采纳与利益相关者典型偏见相悖的建议，即若企业建议监管则实施监管，若环保组织建议不监管则不予监管。若无此类建议，监管者应优先考虑那些偏见较小但未知的利益相关者所提交的意见。接下来，我们将理论结果与欧盟化学品监管实践进行对比。与理论相符，我们发现当支持监管的意见来自企业时，对监管决策具有强烈且显著的影响；而当支持来自非政府组织和环保机构时，则无此影响。同时，我们还发现国家当局在监管决策中的影响力大于其他利益相关者，这既体现在意见的数量上，也体现在相对支持度上。

title: Industry salary signals and adjustments in college entrance examination admission scores for majors: evidence from China’s Double First-Class universities
title_zh: 行业薪酬信号与高考专业录取分数线的调整：来自中国“双一流”大学的证据
title_primary: 行业薪酬信号与高考专业录取分数线的调整：来自中国“双一流”大学的证据
title_secondary: Industry salary signals and adjustments in college entrance examination admission scores for majors: evidence from China’s Double First-Class universities
authors: Meina Li, Yiping Wu, Cai Zhou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The choice of a major in higher education is closely associated with the sector of activity of future employment. As a labour price signal, the industry salary level is transmitted to candidates through the labour market and affects their choice of major. Drawing on panel data matching college entrance examination admission scores of majors with industry salary levels from 147 Chinese ‘Double First-Class’ universities during 2019–2023, this study employs fixed-effects panel regression models to explore the mechanism underlying the effect of industry salary levels on college entrance examination admission scores for corresponding majors. The findings indicate that rising industry salary levels significantly increase the college entrance examination admission scores of relevant majors, and that the rising popularity of majors and the improvement in teaching quality are important factors contributing to these higher admission scores. More importantly, the increasing salary levels of upstream industries also contribute to higher college entrance examination admission scores for majors related to the target industry. From the perspective of salary signals, this article provides empirical evidence regarding the major choices of college entrance examination candidates, the structure of university majors, and the improvement of the talent supply–demand matching mechanism. KEYWORDS: Industry salary level price signal college entrance examination score for majors Double First-Class universities JEL CLASSIFICATION: J31 J24 I21
abstract_zh: 高等教育专业选择与未来就业的行业领域密切相关。作为劳动力价格信号，行业薪酬水平通过劳动力市场传递给考生，并影响其专业选择。本研究利用2019—2023年间147所中国“双一流”高校的专业高考录取分数与行业薪酬水平相匹配的面板数据，采用固定效应面板回归模型，探讨行业薪酬水平对相应专业高考录取分数的影响机制。研究结果表明，行业薪酬水平的上升显著提高了相关专业的高考录取分数，而专业热度的上升及教学质量的提升是推动录取分数提高的重要因素。更为重要的是，上游行业薪酬水平的提升同样有助于提高目标行业相关专业的高考录取分数。本文从薪酬信号视角，为高考考生的专业选择、高校专业结构设置及人才供需匹配机制的完善提供了经验证据。关键词：行业薪酬水平；价格信号；专业高考录取分数；双一流高校 JEL分类：J31 J24 I21

title: Polygyny as a determinant of migration
title_zh: 一夫多妻制作为迁移的决定因素
title_primary: 一夫多妻制作为迁移的决定因素
title_secondary: Polygyny as a determinant of migration
authors: Koopmans, Ruud, Meierrieks, Daniel
official: 官方在线 2026-08-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We hypothesize that polygyny acts as a significant push factor for migration in sub-Saharan Africa because it is associated with competition within polygynous families and on the marriage market, while also contributing to unfavorable economic and political outcomes at the societal level. Using cross-country data from 46 sub-Saharan African countries, we show that higher polygyny prevalence is associated with increased international emigration. We complement this macro-level evidence with original survey data from Senegal, the Gambia, and Nigeria. We show that polygyny is also associated with higher migration aspirations and observed migration of survey respondents’ siblings at the individual level. Respondents from polygynous families tend to report stronger economic motives for migration, while those concerned about the marriage market effects of polygyny—regardless of family background—are more likely to consider migrating for marriage. This highlights two distinct pathways—competition within polygynous families and on marriage markets—linking polygyny to migration.
abstract_zh: 我们假设，在撒哈拉以南非洲，一夫多妻制作为迁移的重要推动因素，因其与多妻家庭内部及婚姻市场上的竞争相关，同时也在社会层面导致不利的经济和政治后果。利用来自46个撒哈拉以南非洲国家的跨国数据，我们显示，一夫多妻制的普遍程度越高，国际移民外流越多。我们以来自塞内加尔、冈比亚和尼日利亚的原始调查数据补充这一宏观层面的证据。我们表明，在个体层面，一夫多妻制也与更高的迁移愿望及调查对象兄弟姐妹的实际迁移相关。来自多妻家庭的受访者倾向于报告更强的经济迁移动机，而那些担忧一夫多妻制对婚姻市场影响的人——无论家庭背景如何——更可能考虑为婚姻而迁移。这凸显了将一夫多妻制与迁移联系起来的两种不同路径：多妻家庭内部的竞争和婚姻市场上的竞争。

title: The Power of Words: Adult Literacy Campaign and Intergenerational Transmission of Human Capital
title_zh: 语言的力量：成人扫盲运动与人力资本的代际传递
title_primary: 语言的力量：成人扫盲运动与人力资本的代际传递
title_secondary: The Power of Words: Adult Literacy Campaign and Intergenerational Transmission of Human Capital
authors: Shuo Chen, Zhuoer Lin, Xian Xu, Yanfei Yin
abstract: We examine the intergenerational impact of China’s 1950s adult literacy campaign, one of the largest anti-illiteracy efforts in history, reaching 150 million people. While direct effects on adult literacy remain debated, we document significant long-term benefits for the next generation’s education. Using an original dataset compiled from county gazetteers and the population census, we find a notable increase in educational attainment for children whose parents were more strongly exposed to the campaign. We attribute these results to extensive government propaganda that likely shifted population attitudes toward education. Our findings suggest that education campaigns can be a viable strategy in developing countries for improving human capital.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了中国20世纪50年代成人扫盲运动的代际影响，这是历史上规模最大的扫盲行动之一，惠及1.5亿人。尽管对成人识字率的直接影响仍存争议，但我们记录了该运动对下一代教育产生的显著长期益处。利用从县志和人口普查中汇编的原始数据集，我们发现，父母受该运动影响更深的子女，其教育成就显著提高。我们将这些结果归因于广泛的政府宣传，这可能改变了民众对教育的态度。我们的研究结果表明，在发展中国家，教育运动可作为提升人力资本的可行策略。

title: An equilibrium theory of nominal exchange rates
title_zh: 名义汇率均衡理论
title_primary: 名义汇率均衡理论
title_secondary: An equilibrium theory of nominal exchange rates
authors: Marcus Hagedorn
abstract: This paper proposes an equilibrium theory of nominal exchange rates, which offers a new perspective on various issues in open economy macroeconomics. The nominal exchange rate and portfolio choices are jointly determined in equilibrium, thus providing a new approach to overcoming the indeterminacy results in Kareken and Wallace (1981). The distinctive features of this theory are that the nominal exchange rate is determined in international financial markets, that the risk premium and UIP deviations are fully endogenous equilibrium objects and that the real exchange rate inherits its properties from the nominal exchange rate. In terms of policy, this novel theory implies that a country with an exchange rate peg and free asset mobility faces a tetralemma and not a trilemma, because it loses not only monetary policy independence but also fiscal policy independence.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种名义汇率的均衡理论，为开放经济宏观经济学中的诸多问题提供了新视角。名义汇率与资产组合选择在均衡中共同决定，从而为克服卡雷肯与华莱士（1981）中的不确定性结果提供了新途径。该理论的独特之处在于，名义汇率在国际金融市场上确定，风险溢价与未覆盖利率平价偏离均为完全内生的均衡对象，且实际汇率继承了名义汇率的属性。在政策层面，这一新颖理论意味着，实行汇率挂钩且资产自由流动的国家面临的是“四难困境”而非“三难困境”，因为它不仅丧失了货币政策独立性，也丧失了财政政策独立性。

title: Labor Supply and the Pension Contribution-Benefit Link
title_zh: 劳动力供给与养老金缴费-待遇关联
title_primary: 劳动力供给与养老金缴费-待遇关联
title_secondary: Labor Supply and the Pension Contribution-Benefit Link
authors: Eric French, Attila Lindner, Cormac O’Dea, Tom Zawisza
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-29 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate the impact of public pension incentives on labor supply far from the normal retirement age by exploiting Poland's switch from a Defined Benefit to a Notional Defined Contribution (NDC) scheme. This reform created a sharp cohort-based discontinuity in the link between current pension contributions and future benefits. Using this discontinuity and the universe of taxpayers, we estimate an employment elasticity with respect to the net return to work of 0.51 for men at ages 51-54. We estimate a lifecycle model to match these responses and discuss the broader implications of the reform. The shift to NDC reallocates work incentives over the lifecycle, strengthening incentives at younger ages, when labor supply is relatively inelastic, and weakening them at older ages, when labor supply is more elastic. This reallocation of work incentives tends to reduce aggregate lifecycle labor supply, which highlights the advantage of targeting pension incentives towards ages at which labor supply is most responsive.
abstract_zh: 本文利用波兰从待遇确定型（DB）向名义账户制（NDC）转型的改革，评估了公共养老金激励对远未达到正常退休年龄人群劳动供给的影响。该改革在当期养老金缴费与未来福利之间的关联中，形成了基于出生队列的显著断点。

title: Horizontal regulatory barriers in international trade: Evidence from electric plugs
title_zh: 国际贸易中的横向监管壁垒：来自电源插头的证据
title_primary: 国际贸易中的横向监管壁垒：来自电源插头的证据
title_secondary: Horizontal regulatory barriers in international trade: Evidence from electric plugs
authors: Y. Mei, Mingzhi Xu
abstract: Domestic policies regulating the horizontal dimensions of product differentiation can impede international trade and have become a major concern in contemporary trade negotiations. We estimate trade frictions associated with incompatible designs of electric plugs, a well-known example of a horizontal regulatory barrier. Our findings indicate that fewer electronic devices are exported to destinations with incompatible electric plugs, and this effect operates through both the extensive margin and the intensive margin of exports. These results are further corroborated by an online survey of Chinese electronics exporters. Moreover, incompatible plugs are associated with lower average quality of exported electronic devices, suggesting that horizontal regulatory barriers are linked to variation in the vertical dimension of product differentiation.
abstract_zh: 国内政策对产品差异化横向维度的规制可能阻碍国际贸易，并已成为当代贸易谈判中的主要关切。我们估算了与电源插头不兼容设计相关的贸易摩擦，这是横向监管壁垒的一个著名例子。研究结果表明，出口至电源插头不兼容目的地的电子设备数量减少，且这一效应通过出口的扩展边际和集约边际同时发挥作用。这些结果进一步得到对中国电子产品出口商的在线调查的佐证。此外，不兼容的插头与出口电子设备的平均质量较低相关联，这表明横向监管壁垒与产品差异化的纵向维度变化存在联系。

title: The long decline of trust in democratic institutions
title_zh: 民主制度信任的长期衰退
title_primary: 民主制度信任的长期衰退
title_secondary: The long decline of trust in democratic institutions
authors: Sam Peltzman
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: I document declining trust in the Executive and Legislative branches of the US federal government from 1972 onwards. Data are from General Social Survey questions asking whether respondents “have a great deal”, “only some,” or “hardly any” confidence “in those running these institutions”. Net confidence (percentage difference between “great deal” and “hardly any”) in the two branches has declined continually from nearly zero in the early 1970s, accelerating substantially from the 1990s on. Different processes drive this decline for each branch. Partisan and ideological opponents of the President increasingly distrust the incumbent while supporters are roughly neutral. Trust in the US Congress has been eroding more uniformly across all parties and ideologies. In recent years net confidence has been around -30 for the Executive and -45 for Congress. This profound distrust (10 times as many have hardly any v a great deal of confidence in Congress) is widely shared across main socio-demographics, such as age, gender, income, etc., though the decline is steeper for older and white respondents. The decline is also greater than for other institutions, including until recently the third branch (Supreme Court). I close by discussing implications for research in public choice.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了自1972年以来美国联邦政府行政与立法部门公信力持续下降的趋势。数据来源于综合社会调查中关于受访者对"这些机构管理者"信任程度的问题，选项包括"非常信任"、"部分信任"和"几乎不信任"。两部门的净信任度（"非常信任"与"几乎不信任"的百分比差值）从20世纪70年代初接近零的水平持续下滑，自20世纪90年代起加速恶化。不同部门公信力下降的驱动机制存在差异：总统的党派与意识形态反对者对其不信任程度持续加深，而支持者基本保持中立；美国国会的公信力则在所有党派与意识形态群体中呈现更均匀的侵蚀态势。近年来，行政部门的净信任度约为-30，国会约为-45。这种深度不信任（对国会"几乎不信任"的受访者数量是"非常信任"的十倍）广泛存在于年龄、性别、收入等主要社会人口学群体中，但老年群体和白人受访者的下降幅度更为显著。与其他机构（包括近期之前的第三部门——最高法院）相比，其下降幅度也更为突出。本文最后探讨了该现象对公共选择研究的启示。

title: The role of structural transformation in regional convergence in Japan: 1874–2008
title_zh: 日本区域趋同中的结构转型作用：1874–2008
title_primary: 日本区域趋同中的结构转型作用：1874–2008
title_secondary: The role of structural transformation in regional convergence in Japan: 1874–2008
authors: Kyoji Fukao, Saumik Paul
abstract: Japan's regional convergence of productivity levels throughout the twentieth century can be best described as a cumulative process of ‘catching up, forging ahead, and falling behind’. Using a novel dataset spanning 135 years (1874–2008), this study finds support for a crucial role played by structural transformation in convergence. The pace of productivity catch‐up and convergence accelerated in the mid‐1950s with the help of structural transformation, particularly in the period from 1955 to 1965. Structural transformation explains, on average, about 30 per cent of the aggregate productivity growth, and its effect intensified in prefectures with faster movements of labour across sectors and larger sectoral productivity gaps. However, since the early 1970s, its contribution to the convergence was frequently offset by within‐sector productivity growth, in turn thwarting the pace of convergence. These counter‐balancing effects contributed to the diverse pathways of productivity catch‐up at the prefecture level.
abstract_zh: 20世纪日本各区域生产率水平的收敛过程，可被最恰当地描述为“追赶、领先与落后”的累积性进程。本研究利用覆盖135年（1874-2008年）的新数据集，发现结构转型在收敛过程中发挥了关键作用。20世纪50年代中期，在结构转型的推动下，生产率追赶与收敛速度显著加快，尤其在1955年至1965年期间。结构转型平均解释了约30%的总体生产率增长，且其效应在劳动力跨部门流动更快、部门间生产率差距更大的县级行政区中更为显著。然而自20世纪70年代初以来，结构转型对收敛的贡献常被部门内生产率增长所抵消，进而阻碍了收敛进程。这些相互抵消的效应导致了县级层面生产率追赶路径的多元化。

title: Asymptotic Distributions of Nonlinear Least Squares Estimators for Panel-MIDAS Models
title_zh: 面板-MIDAS模型非线性最小二乘估计量的渐近分布
title_primary: 面板-MIDAS模型非线性最小二乘估计量的渐近分布
title_secondary: Asymptotic Distributions of Nonlinear Least Squares Estimators for Panel-MIDAS Models
authors: Min Lin, Han Lin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The Mixed Data Sampling (MIDAS) approach provides a flexible framework for incorporating mixed-frequency data into econometric models. In this paper, we introduce the MIDAS framework into a panel data model and derive the asymptotic properties of the NLS estimator under a joint asymptotic framework where both N and T tend to infinity, allowing for heteroskedasticity and arbitrary correlation within each individual. To facilitate valid inference, we construct robust heteroskedasticity- and autocorrelation-consistent (HAC) covariance estimators. We also analyze the asymptotic bias and variance of the LS estimator based on pre-specified aggregation weights. In addition, we propose a Wald test for the null hypothesis of equal weights and a supremum-type Wald test to address the unidentified nuisance parameter problem. The theoretical results are evaluated via an extensive Monte Carlo simulation study and an empirical application.
abstract_zh: 混合数据抽样（MIDAS）方法为将混合频率数据纳入计量经济模型提供了一个灵活的框架。本文将该MIDAS框架引入面板数据模型，并在联合渐近框架下（其中N和T均趋于无穷大）推导了非线性最小二乘（NLS）估计量的渐近性质，该框架允许异方差性及个体内部的任意相关性。为便于有效推断，我们构建了稳健的异方差性和自相关一致性（HAC）协方差估计量。我们还分析了基于预设聚合权重的LS估计量的渐近偏差和方差。此外，我们提出了一个用于检验等权重原假设的Wald检验，以及一个上确界型Wald检验，以解决未识别冗余参数问题。理论结果通过广泛的蒙特卡洛模拟研究和实证应用进行了评估。

title: Non-Tariff Barriers in the U.S.-China Trade War
title_zh: 中美贸易战中的非关税壁垒
title_primary: 中美贸易战中的非关税壁垒
title_secondary: Non-Tariff Barriers in the U.S.-China Trade War
authors: Chen, Tuo, Hsieh, Chang-Tai, Song, Zheng (Michael)
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Unofficial non-tariff barriers were responsible for 50% of the reduction in Chinese imports from the U.S. during the 2018-2019 trade war. We infer NTBs from the change in imports of U.S. products relative to imports from other countries of the same HS6 product, after controlling for the change in the relative price of U.S. imports. NTBs were imposed on a small number of agricultural products, did not apply to state-owned importers, and larger for products with a high share of state importers. NTBs are more costly compared to tariffs because they only apply to some importers do not generate revenues.
abstract_zh: 在2018-2019年贸易战期间，非官方非关税壁垒导致中国从美国进口减少的50%。我们通过控制美国进口相对价格变化后，比较美国产品进口变化与同一HS6产品从其他国家进口变化来推断非关税壁垒的存在。非关税壁垒仅针对少数农产品实施，不适用于国有进口商，且对国有进口商占比较高的产品影响更大。与关税相比，非关税壁垒成本更高，因其仅适用于部分进口商且不产生财政收入。

title: Competition between green and blue hydrogen and indirect network effects 1
title_zh: 绿色氢与蓝色氢的竞争及间接网络效应
title_primary: 绿色氢与蓝色氢的竞争及间接网络效应
title_secondary: Competition between green and blue hydrogen and indirect network effects 1
authors: Kine Josefine Aurland-Bredesen, Rolf Golombek, Mads Greaker
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Whereas hydrogen is currently a marginal energy carrier, the aim of the EU is to trigger low-carbon hydrogen production that covers around 10 percent of EU’s energy needs by 2050. If this comes true, it will be an energy revolution. We study competition between green and blue hydrogen using an extended Salop model that encompasses the value chains for hydrogen and CCS. For blue hydrogen, we distinguish between exports of blue hydrogen—natural gas is converted into hydrogen close to the extraction site of natural gas and hydrogen is then transported over a long distance to the hydrogen consumers—and local production of blue hydrogen—natural gas is exported over a long distance and then converted into hydrogen near the hydrogen consumers. We find that mark-ups are highest in the case of exports of blue hydrogen production, which implies that total production of hydrogen, supply of blue hydrogen, and share of plants investing in carbon capture facilities are lower in the case of exports of blue hydrogen than in the case of local production of blue hydrogen. We provide numerical simulations of the alternative market outcomes and the corresponding first-best outcomes and identify policy instruments that should be used to sustain the first-best social outcomes in the cases of exports of blue hydrogen and local production of blue hydrogen.
abstract_zh: 尽管氢能目前仍是一种边缘能源载体，欧盟的目标是到2050年推动低碳氢能生产，使其覆盖欧盟约10%的能源需求。若这一目标实现，将引发一场能源革命。我们通过扩展萨洛普模型（Salop model）研究绿色氢能与蓝色氢能之间的竞争，该模型涵盖了氢能与碳捕集与封存（CCS）的价值链。针对蓝色氢能，我们区分了两种模式：蓝色氢能出口（在天然气开采地附近将天然气转化为氢能，再通过长距离运输至氢能消费端）与蓝色氢能本地生产（将天然气长距离出口至氢能消费端附近，再转化为氢能）。研究发现，蓝色氢能出口模式下的加价幅度最高，这意味着相较于蓝色氢能本地生产模式，出口模式下的氢能总产量、蓝色氢能供应量以及投资碳捕集设施的工厂占比均更低。我们通过数值模拟对比了不同市场结果与对应的最优社会结果，并识别出在蓝色氢能出口与本地生产两种模式下，用于维持最优社会结果的政策工具。

title: The economic footprint of Europe’s defence build-up
title_zh: 欧洲防务建设的经济足迹
title_primary: 欧洲防务建设的经济足迹
title_secondary: The economic footprint of Europe’s defence build-up
authors: Luiz de Mello, Ines Dezcallar, Sean Dougherty
abstract: Defence policy is usually discussed as a national security issue, but its economic effects are often highly local. This column presents new evidence from 1,011 regions in 15 European countries suggesting that places hosting defence production and supply chain activity have a larger economic footprint than comparable places without such activity: they enjoy higher income levels, and the premium is especially large in more innovative regions. As Europe raises defence spending, the geography of where that money ultimately lands may matter almost as much as the total amount.
abstract_zh: 国防政策通常被视为国家安全议题，但其经济效应往往具有高度地方性。本文基于15个欧洲国家1011个地区的新证据表明，承接国防生产及供应链活动的地区，其经济规模显著大于未开展此类活动的可比地区：这些地区享有更高收入水平，且在创新程度更高的地区，这种经济溢价尤为突出。随着欧洲增加国防开支，资金最终流向的地理分布可能与支出总额同等重要。

title: Understanding Cross-State Variations in Medicaid Enrollment During and After the COVID-19 Pandemic
title_zh: 新冠疫情期间及之后医疗补助参保率的跨州差异研究
title_primary: 新冠疫情期间及之后医疗补助参保率的跨州差异研究
title_secondary: Understanding Cross-State Variations in Medicaid Enrollment During and After the COVID-19 Pandemic
authors: Jeffrey Clemens, Helena Detering, Anwita Mahajan
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The implementation and unwinding of the FFCRA's continuous coverage requirement generated historically large changes in Medicaid enrollment during the COVID-19 pandemic. Using a combination of descriptive and causal analyses, we examine the substantial cross-state differences in these changes, which remain little understood. We find that policies designed to ease unwinding frictions, as well as federal fiscal assistance to states, have little predictive power, suggesting limited roles for administrative design or liquidity constraints. Political preferences have modest predictive power during the unwinding period. Pandemic-era Medicaid expansions and more generous baseline eligibility thresholds are strongly associated with larger net enrollment gains.
abstract_zh: FFCRA持续覆盖要求的实施与解除，导致新冠疫情期间医疗补助计划参保人数出现历史性的大幅波动。通过结合描述性分析与因果分析，我们研究了各州在这些变化中存在的显著差异——这些差异至今仍鲜有深入理解。研究发现，旨在缓解解除摩擦的政策以及联邦对各州的财政援助，其预测能力均较弱，表明行政设计或流动性约束的作用有限。政治倾向在解除期间仅具有适度的预测能力。疫情期间医疗补助计划的扩展以及更宽松的基线资格门槛，与更大的净参保人数增长显著相关。

title: Optimal Currency Basket Estimation
title_zh: 最优货币篮子估计
title_primary: 最优货币篮子估计
title_secondary: Optimal Currency Basket Estimation
authors: Mr. Etienne Vaccaro-Grange
official: 官方在线 2026-06-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Small open economies often anchor their exchange rate to a basket of foreign currencies, with weights typically set from trade shares or financial exposure. Such schemes ignore the heterogeneity of pass-through across currencies and the covariance structure of bilateral rates, and therefore do not minimize the volatility of imported inflation, the central bank’s mandate. This paper proposes a minimum-variance framework — formally analogous to a Markowitz portfolio problem in pass-through space — in which basket weights minimize the variance of exchange-rate-driven imported inflation, subject to a constraint that preserves the basket’s cumulative pass-through. Applied to the case of Fiji, an import-intensive island economy with a five-currency basket, the optimization reduces the variance of imported inflation by close to twenty percent, with results robust across alternative specifications.
abstract_zh: 小型开放经济体通常将本币汇率与一篮子外币挂钩，权重通常根据贸易份额或金融敞口设定。此类方案忽略了汇率传导在不同货币间的异质性以及双边汇率的协方差结构，因此无法最小化进口通胀的波动性——而这正是央行的政策目标。本文提出一个最小方差框架——在形式上类似于汇率传导空间中的马科维茨投资组合问题——在该框架下，一篮子货币的权重在保持篮子累积汇率传导效应的约束条件下，最小化汇率驱动的进口通胀方差。将该方法应用于斐济这一进口密集型岛国（其采用五货币篮子）的案例后，优化方案使进口通胀方差降低近20%，且结果在不同设定下均保持稳健。

title: Urbanizing commons lands: Ambiguous tenure regimes and the challenges of land regularization in Guadalajara Metropolitan Region, Mexico
title_zh: 城市化中的公共土地：模糊的产权制度与墨西哥瓜达拉哈拉大都市区土地正规化的挑战

title: News on asymmetric fiscal multipliers
title_zh: 不对称财政乘数新闻
title_primary: 不对称财政乘数新闻
title_secondary: News on asymmetric fiscal multipliers
authors: Andrea Cappelletti
abstract: This paper investigates the asymmetric effects of expansionary and contractionary fiscal shocks in the U.S. economy using a state-of-the-art non-linear local projection framework. To identify fiscal shocks, I use a proxy based on revisions to the mean forecast of government spending growth from the Survey of Professional Forecasters, which represent unexpected changes in expectations about government spending. The estimated fiscal multipliers are larger following positive fiscal shocks than following negative ones, indicating asymmetric effects of fiscal policy interventions.
abstract_zh: 本文运用前沿的非线性局部投影框架，研究了美国经济中扩张性与紧缩性财政冲击的非对称效应。为识别财政冲击，我采用基于专业预测者调查中政府支出增长平均预测修正的代理变量，这些修正反映了对政府支出预期的意外变化。估计结果显示，正向财政冲击后的财政乘数大于负向冲击后的乘数，表明财政政策干预存在非对称效应。

title: Fertilising Climate Policy: The Dual Impact of CBAM on EU Agricultural Emissions and Regional Disparities
title_zh: 施肥气候政策：CBAM对欧盟农业排放与区域差异的双重影响
title_primary: 施肥气候政策：CBAM对欧盟农业排放与区域差异的双重影响
title_secondary: Fertilising Climate Policy: The Dual Impact of CBAM on EU Agricultural Emissions and Regional Disparities
authors: Davit Stepanyan, Omid Zamani, Claudia Heidecke, Janine Pelikan, Jörg Rieger 等
abstract: The Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM), scheduled to become fully operational in 2026, is designed to complement the EU Emissions Trading System (ETS) by replacing free emission allowances and preventing carbon leakage to non‐EU regions. CBAM initially covers energy‐intensive sectors, including mineral nitrogen (N) fertiliser production. Although mineral N fertiliser production is already included in the EU ETS, it is currently exempt from carbon charges owing to full compensation through free allowances. The phase‐out of these allowances and the introduction of CBAM are expected to increase the prices of both imported and domestically produced fertilisers, indirectly affecting the EU agricultural sector. This study quantitatively assesses the impacts of the expected fertiliser price changes on the EU agricultural sector and related environmental outcomes using the Modular Applied GeNeral Equilibrium Tool (MAGNET) and the Common Agricultural Policy Regionalised Impact (CAPRI) model. The results indicate that the combined effect of phasing out free allowances and implementing CBAM will double mineral N fertiliser prices. Higher prices are projected to reduce demand, leading to a 21.4% decline in domestic production and a 37% reduction in imports. Overall mineral N fertiliser use in the EU is expected to decrease by 22%, partially replaced by manure. Consequently, EU agricultural factor income is projected to fall by 7.7%, primarily affecting high‐input regions. Meanwhile, non‐EU agricultural income is projected to rise slightly by 0.05%, driven by higher exports. EU agricultural greenhouse gas emissions are expected to decrease by 22 megatons of CO 2 ‐equivalent, with no significant increase globally.
abstract_zh: 碳边境调节机制（CBAM）计划于2026年全面实施，旨在通过取代免费排放配额并防止碳泄漏至非欧盟地区，对欧盟排放交易体系（ETS）形成补充。CBAM最初覆盖能源密集型行业，包括矿物氮肥生产。尽管矿物氮肥生产已被纳入欧盟ETS，但目前因通过免费配额获得全额补偿而免于碳成本。这些配额的逐步取消及CBAM的引入预计将推高进口和本土化肥价格，间接影响欧盟农业部门。本研究采用模块化应用一般均衡工具（MAGNET）与共同农业政策区域化影响模型（CAPRI），定量评估预期化肥价格变化对欧盟农业部门及相关环境结果的影响。结果表明，取消免费配额与实施CBAM的叠加效应将使矿物氮肥价格翻倍。价格上涨预计将抑制需求，导致本土产量下降21.4%，进口量减少37%。欧盟矿物氮肥总使用量预计下降22%，部分被粪肥替代。受此影响，欧盟农业要素收入预计下降7.7%，高投入地区受冲击最为显著。与此同时，非欧盟地区农业收入因出口增长预计小幅上升0.05%。欧盟农业温室气体排放预计减少2200万吨二氧化碳当量，且全球范围内未出现显著增长。

title: Direct and Indirect Treatment Effects With Time‐Varying Covariates
title_zh: 时变协变量下的直接与间接处理效应
title_primary: 时变协变量下的直接与间接处理效应
title_secondary: Direct and Indirect Treatment Effects With Time‐Varying Covariates
authors: Nicholas L. Brown, Kyle Butts, Joakim Westerlund
abstract: We propose a simple approach to treatment effect estimation in panel data that is valid when the number of time periods is small and the parallel trends condition is violated due to the presence of interactive fixed effects. The procedure allows the covariates to be affected by treatment and enables separation of the part of the estimated treatment effect that is due to the covariates from the part that is not. The asymptotic properties of the new approach are established, and their accuracy in small samples is investigated using Monte Carlo simulations. The procedure is illustrated using as an example the effect of increased trade competition on firm markups in China. We estimate that about half of the impact of China's entrance into the WTO on markup dispersion came from the changes in industry‐level productivity.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种在面板数据中估计处理效应的简便方法，该方法在时间期数较少且因存在交互固定效应而违反平行趋势假设时依然有效。该程序允许协变量受处理影响，并能将估计处理效应中归因于协变量的部分与不归因于协变量的部分分离开来。我们确立了新方法的渐近性质，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟研究了其在小样本中的准确性。以中国贸易竞争加剧对企业加成率的影响为例，对该程序进行了说明。我们估计，中国加入WTO对加成率离散度影响中，约有一半来自行业层面生产率的变化。

title: A comment on “Quality standards, industry structure, and welfare in a global economy”
title_zh: 对《质量标准、产业结构与全球经济中的福利》一文的评论
title_primary: 对《质量标准、产业结构与全球经济中的福利》一文的评论
title_secondary: A comment on “Quality standards, industry structure, and welfare in a global economy”
authors: Dao‐Zhi Zeng
abstract: Gaigné and Larue (American Journal of Agricultural Economics 98:1432–1449) examined the welfare implications of quality regulations within an international trade context, employing a general-equilibrium framework. Their study uses a CES (Constant Elasticity of Substitution) model and finds that stricter public standards might improve welfare. However, this conclusion was actually derived from a partial-equilibrium analysis. This note conducts a thorough general-equilibrium analysis and demonstrates that their anticipated outcome does not hold within their CES framework.
abstract_zh: Gaigné和Larue（《美国农业经济学杂志》98:1432–1449）在国际贸易背景下考察了质量规制的福利影响，采用了一般均衡框架。他们的研究使用CES（恒定替代弹性）模型，并发现更严格的公共标准可能改善福利。然而，这一结论实际上源自于局部均衡分析。本文进行了全面的一般均衡分析，并证明在其CES框架内，他们预期的结果并不成立。

title: Social welfare effects of annuitization in small open economies
title_zh: 小开放经济中年金化的社会福利效应
title_primary: 小开放经济中年金化的社会福利效应
title_secondary: Social welfare effects of annuitization in small open economies
authors: Tim D. Maurer
abstract: This paper develops a theory of when annuitization improves or reduces social welfare. The analysis is based on a small open economy with exogenous prices, populated by overlapping generations of non-altruistic agents. Annuities provide longevity risk insurance and above-market returns, but also reduce accidental bequests that transfer resources from the old to the young. I show that the welfare trade-off between these channels is governed by the interest rate: above a threshold, the cost of reducing bequests dominates and no annuitization is socially optimal; below it, partial annuitization improves welfare. Socially optimal allocations can be implemented by mandating a savings portfolio with a predetermined share invested in annuities. Governments that instead mandate annuities through fully funded pensions cannot replicate these allocations, even when annuity markets are missing and agents cannot borrow against future benefits. Although derived for small open economies, the results provide a benchmark for identifying when annuitization raises or lowers welfare and presumably extend to closed economies, where the boundary may still depend on the rate of return but now through threshold values of the parameters that determine it.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个理论框架，探讨年金化何时能增进或降低社会福利。分析基于一个价格外生的小型开放经济体，其中居住着无利他主义的世代交叠个体。年金提供长寿风险保险及高于市场水平的回报，但同时也减少了将资源从老年一代转移至年轻一代的意外遗产。研究表明，这些渠道间的福利权衡由利率决定：当利率高于某一阈值时，减少遗产的代价占据主导，此时不进行年金化是社会最优选择；而当利率低于该阈值时，部分年金化能提升社会福利。社会最优配置可通过强制规定储蓄组合中投资于年金的预定比例来实现。相比之下，即使年金市场缺失且个体无法以未来收益为抵押借款，政府通过完全基金制养老金强制推行年金也无法复制这些最优配置。尽管结论源于小型开放经济模型，但为识别年金化提升或降低福利的条件提供了基准，并可能推广至封闭经济，其中边界仍可能依赖于回报率，但此时是通过决定回报率的参数阈值来体现。

title: Banks and Inequality: Evidence from a Nationwide Branch Expansion Policy
title_zh: 银行与不平等：来自全国性分行扩张政策的证据
title_primary: 银行与不平等：来自全国性分行扩张政策的证据
title_secondary: Banks and Inequality: Evidence from a Nationwide Branch Expansion Policy
authors: ASHISH K. SEDAI, MAHMUT YASAR, WILLIAM CROWDER, RIKHIA BHUKTA
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
abstract: We analyze the causal impact of a nationwide bank expansion policy on economic inequality in India using a regression discontinuity design (RDD). The findings reveal significant reductions in both consumption and wealth inequality, driven by economic growth and structural transformation. We document strong ‐convergence in consumption and income, with middle‐income households experiencing the largest relative gains, underscoring the role of financial access in accelerating upward mobility. Our results demonstrate that bank expansion fosters economic diversification, supporting nonagricultural development and narrowing regional disparities. This paper contributes to the literature by providing evidence on how large‐scale financial inclusion policies reshape regional inequality dynamics and drive inclusive growth in developing economies.
abstract_zh: 我们采用断点回归设计（RDD），分析了印度全国性银行扩张政策对经济不平等的因果影响。研究结果显示，该政策显著降低了消费和财富不平等，这一效应主要由经济增长和结构转型驱动。我们记录了消费和收入方面的强σ-收敛现象，其中中等收入家庭获得了最大的相对收益，凸显了金融可及性在加速向上流动性中的作用。我们的结果表明，银行扩张促进了经济多元化，支持了非农业发展，并缩小了区域差距。本文通过提供关于大规模金融包容性政策如何重塑区域不平等动态并推动发展中经济体包容性增长的证据，为现有文献做出了贡献。

title: Somebody Knows Something: Managerial Ability, Product Development, and Return‐on‐Investment in a Hit‐Driven Industry
title_zh: 有人知道些什么：经理能力、产品开发与热门驱动型行业的投资回报
title_primary: 有人知道些什么：经理能力、产品开发与热门驱动型行业的投资回报
title_secondary: Somebody Knows Something: Managerial Ability, Product Development, and Return‐on‐Investment in a Hit‐Driven Industry
authors: Darren Filson
abstract: In hit‐driven industries, product development is associated with a right‐skewed unconditional distribution of performance, and products in the right tail have outsized impacts. Understanding how exceptional performance is generated can improve resource allocation, but the literature advances two different narratives: one emphasizes postrelease demand discovery, and the other emphasizes prerelease factors, including project quality, management teams, and uncertainties associated with product development. The model in this paper facilitates assessing the relative importance of the different narratives. Estimation employs data on movies—the primary setting where demand discovery has been emphasized. The results reject the primacy of demand discovery; most project‐specific variation in return‐on‐investment is associated with uncertainty resolved during product development. Higher managerial ability is associated with better product‐development performance. Parameter estimates are compatible with nearly efficient and approximately positive assortative matching of projects and managers. The results suggest that emphasizing prerelease factors should be the presumptive narrative in all hit‐driven industries.
abstract_zh: 在热门驱动型行业中，产品开发与右偏的无条件绩效分布相关联，右尾产品具有超常影响力。理解卓越绩效如何产生有助于优化资源配置，但文献中提出了两种不同的叙事：一种强调发布后的需求发现，另一种则强调发布前的因素，包括项目质量、管理团队及产品开发相关的不确定性。本文构建的模型有助于评估不同叙事的相对重要性。估计采用电影数据——这是需求发现被强调的主要场景。结果否定了需求发现的首要地位；投资回报中大部分项目特定变异与产品开发期间解决的不确定性相关。更高的管理能力与更好的产品开发绩效相关联。参数估计与项目和管理者之间近乎高效且近似正选型匹配相容。结果表明，在所有热门驱动型行业中，强调发布前因素应成为默认叙事。

title: Inflation Co-movement between Latin America and the US: trends versus cycles and developments since covid
title_zh: 拉丁美洲与美国通胀联动：趋势与周期及新冠疫情以来的发展
title_primary: 拉丁美洲与美国通胀联动：趋势与周期及新冠疫情以来的发展
title_secondary: Inflation Co-movement between Latin America and the US: trends versus cycles and developments since covid
authors: William Miles
abstract: Inflation convergence with the US is a goal for Latin American nations. Although studies on inflation within countries distinguish between trend and cyclical inflation, papers on co-movement between Latin America and the US have ignored this distinction. We gather quarterly data on inflation for eleven Latin American countries and the US over 1987–2023 to investigate this issue. We employ the Christiano-Fitzgerald filter to decompose inflation into trend and cyclical components, and use metrics of co-movement that go beyond correlation. We find trend inflation is more cohesive than cyclical between the US and Latin America. Co-movement in trend inflation rates have increased more in recent decades than those of cyclical rates. There has been an increase in cohesion between Latin American and US inflation since covid. However, while other works have examined the cohesion between US and Latin (headline) inflation, we are the first to our knowledge to perform a comparison with co-movement of inflation within US regions. This comparison reveals much less association between inflation across nations than there is between the different regions in the US. This is a troubling result for countries that are dollarized, such as Ecuador, which displays a low level of co-movement with US inflation.
abstract_zh: 与美国的通胀趋同是拉丁美洲国家的一个目标。尽管关于国家内部通胀的研究区分了趋势性通胀和周期性通胀，但探讨拉丁美洲与美国之间通胀联动性的论文却忽略了这一区分。我们收集了1987年至2023年间11个拉丁美洲国家和美国的季度通胀数据来研究这一问题。采用克里斯蒂亚诺-菲茨杰拉德滤波器将通胀分解为趋势成分和周期成分，并使用超越相关性的联动性指标。研究发现，美国与拉丁美洲之间的趋势性通胀比周期性通胀更具一致性。近几十年来，趋势性通胀率的联动性增长幅度大于周期性通胀率。自新冠疫情以来，拉丁美洲与美国通胀之间的协同性有所增强。然而，尽管已有研究考察了美国与拉丁美洲（整体）通胀的协同性，但据我们所知，我们是首个将其与美国各地区内部通胀联动性进行比较的研究。这一比较揭示出，国家间的通胀关联性远低于美国各地区之间的关联性。对于实行美元化的国家（如厄瓜多尔）而言，这一结果令人担忧——该国与美国通胀的联动性水平较低。
